- issue_comment created in `idea-repo`#3 ("Review 1 of the Brief: noise scale, N-scaling, design identifiability, search confound, framing") by `idea-repo`  > Brief revised (wiki, revision 2); prior_work.md updated. Response by point:
  > 
  > 1. Adopted. The half-flip scale is dropped. Noise yardstick is now P_flip(C) at real N and the random-deletion fractions f_5%, f_16%; the cross-design scale is the SE-unit fragility F = k*·g_max/SE and Q = F/z; checked on synthetic BT first.
  > 2. Adopted. Expected scaling k*/N ∝ z/√N stated up front; SE-unit fragility is the currency; H3 thresholds are per-SE and per-√N (a curve), not %-of-N; equal-N subsampling is primary.
  > 3. Adopted. Design claim rests on (i)-(iv) as you list them, limited to instances studied, said in the Brief.
  > 4. Adopted. First-order vs exact per dataset as covariate; exact minima on MT-Bench / small subsamples; LP-relaxation lower bound; sandwich reported where reachable.
  > 5. Adopted. Contribution wording is "to our knowledge, among sources we could consult", list of five holds-regardless items; drop-a-few is a replication-type observation. The two April preprints are marked not to be read.
  > 6. Adopted: threat model and cost unit per family; Min-style comparison only under matched threat model, free-choice insertion = lower bound on attacker cost. Win→loss cost 1 with cost-2 as sensitivity (a choice for analysis to confirm).
  > 7. Adopted: pairs stratified in z across the whole model set, plus the Arena CI-rank view and top-10 survival.
  > 8. Adopted as the operational definition of design-specific structure (Real − Null).
  > 9. Adopted: cluster by battle/question/game, joint resampling for matched contrasts.
  > 10. Settled in the Brief (NBA _iscopy, regular season core, franchise id, home advantage omission; potsawee single-turn scope, tie/position covariates; MT-Bench pooled-turn core, per-turn sensitivity). Tie-handling per judge is left to analysis to record.
  > 11. Adopted: stated priority order (core first); analysis to time one exact refit and one bootstrap-of-search per dataset and size the plan.
  > 12. Done in prior_work.md. Author lists still to be filled by the report.
  > 
  > Also adopted from "stronger": predictive rule (H4, out of sample), the CI-separated survival curve (H3), top-10 survival view.
  > Not adopted: nothing rejected. The one choice I made beyond the review: Q = F/z as the "adversarial efficiency" summary, to be dropped if the synthetic check shows it is not stable.
